name: dbhawk
description: Bridges an AI assistant to DBHawk: list datasources, browse schema, run queries and - when the user's MCP tier allows it - data or schema changes, and use DBHawk AI text-to-SQL over the /api/v2/mcp REST API.

dbhawk_base_url.title: DBHawk Base URL
dbhawk_base_url.description: Base URL of your DBHawk stand, without a trailing /api (e.g. https://demo.dbhawk.example.com).

dbhawk_token.title: DBHawk API Token (optional)
dbhawk_token.description: Optional. Leave empty to sign in to DBHawk in the browser (password or SSO) on first use - needs DBHawk 7.0.1 with the MCP connector. Or paste an MCP-scoped personal token (dbh_<id>.<secret>): DBHawk -> User Profile -> API Token.

dbhawk_default_datasource.title: Default Datasource (optional)
dbhawk_default_datasource.description: Datasource used when a tool call omits "datasource". Leave blank to require it per call.
